lines.text: Good morning. Are you in my class? You look like you are not.
Yes? Make it quick. I have a meeting about meetings.
Ah, good morning. You came early. Good. Keep it so.
See me after class.
Go and read. Actually read.
No. Extension is not a human right.
Bring it on Monday. Monday of this week.
Light gone. Carry on. Read the board with your memory.
The generator? Bursary says it's 'in process'. Since 2011.
No fan, no light. Nobody faint. Fainting is not on the attendance.
…and I told them, the course outline is not a suggestion.
The portal is down. Network. Come back yesterday.
Bring the original, two photocopies and your patience.
Is this handwriting or a map of Kwari Dam?
If the light goes, we continue. Knowledge is not on the grid.
Office hours are Tuesday. Today is Tuesday. My office is closed.
Sign the attendance. Only for yourself. I can count.
Which of you is 'Group Four'? All of you? Okay.
When I was a student, we read with a lantern. And we were grateful.
Where is the class rep? Class rep! Come and rep the class!
The memo says 'urgent'. It was written last semester.
Marking at midnight. Somebody wrote a poem in question two.
The night porter says the clock chimed once. That clock does not chime.
Every week the light goes. Every week I bring chalk and courage.
Freshers in the wrong theatre. Again. Every year, the same theatre.
The mall has three generators. My department has one extension box.
Somebody is tapping power from the faculty line. My kettle knows.
I'm on the committee for the new mall. I don't know why.
I support the strike. I also miss my students. Both.
Strike. My office is open if anyone wants to talk. Not teach. Talk.
Students holding free classes under the tree. That is a university.
I'm in a video, apparently. I didn't say that. I said it slower.
Elections. Please. Not in my lecture. Campaign outside.
Everybody is famous this semester. Nobody submitted the assignment.
Project defence on Monday. Chapter three is still a rumour.
Final years. I'll miss failing you. Joking. Mostly.
I watched you go from 'which theatre?' to 'which job?'
Welcome, freshers. Where you sit today is where you sit forever.
Pens down at the bell. Not after. At.
No phones. No notes. No sighing loudly.
Results are out. My office is not a complaints department.
Allowance week. Suddenly the textbook is 'on its way'.
Strike day. The theatre is empty. I came anyway. Habit.
I won't say who I support. Engineering. I said nothing.
Vote with your head. Not your stomach. Not the free biscuits.
Convocation. I'll be in the gown. Hot, proud, slightly late.
Ramadan. Lectures end early so people can break fast. Be on time.
Merry Christmas. The assignment is still due on the fifth.
Valentine's Day is not on the timetable. The quiz is.
Close the windows. The dust is attending without registering.
